title: Mahamanvantara
html_source: According to the Hindus, Mahamanvantara (Sanskrit) [from maha great + manvantara period of manifestation] is a great cycle of cosmic manifestation and activity, whether of a universe, solar system, or planet. Joyce frequently makes reference to Hindu esoteric words, texts and concepts. The mahamanvantara of a solar system also known as the Life of Brahma, is a period of 311,040,000,000,000 terrestrial years. A mahamanvantara of the earth-chain is a Day of Brahma or a period of seven rounds of the planetary chain. The day after the mahamanvantara is termed the Day-Be-With-Us a similar notion to the Christian Day of Judgment. At this point it is said all individualities are merged into one, each still possessing essential or intrinsic knowledge of itself. Hindus also state that at that time, what to us now is non-conscious or the unconscious, will be absolute consciousness.
